value.title: Varkala
value.summary: Varkala is a town in the Indian state of Kerala, about 50 km north of Thiruvananthapuram and is home of the popular Papanasam Beach. Also, the Samadhi of Kerala's saint Sree Narayana Guru is in this town, and has become a place of pilgrimage.
eat_highlights: Almost all hotels and resorts have room service. There are lots of restaurants at the cliff. Most of them and places-to-eat in the cliff are seasonal and spring up during the tourist season (beginning in late November). Try the fresh fish or seafood from any number of the cliff-top restaurants. Seafood is caught by local fishermen and displayed in front of many restaurants. Select your food, have it prepared in the tandoor and enjoy the sunset while you dine.

Abba Restaurant German Bakery: Located on the North Cliff, they bake their own bread which is fresh and delectable. Their breakfast combos are amazing with choice of sausages, grilled veggies, choice of eggs and fresh fruit juices in addition to some excellent coffee. The Nepalese staff here make all kind of dishes from Indian to Continental and Tibetan fare. Food quality is good as one would expect from a German bakery. However fresh sea food is not their strength and there are plenty of other places in the vicinity to give it a try. Breakfast combos are priced between Rs 220 to Rs 300.
